# Protecting Personal Information: A Guide for Business
File
[pdf-0136_proteting-personal-information.pdf](https://www.ftc.gov/system/files/documents/plain-language/pdf-0136_proteting-personal-information.pdf) (1.24 MB)
[https://www.bulkorder.ftc.gov/publications/protecting-personal-information-guid…](https://www.bulkorder.ftc.gov/publications/protecting-personal-information-guide-business)

Given the cost of a security breach—losing your customers’ trust and perhaps even defending yourself against a lawsuit—safeguarding personal information is just plain good business.
Some businesses may have the expertise in-house to implement an appropriate plan. Others may find it helpful to hire a contractor. Regardless of the size—or nature—of your business, the principles in this brochure will go a long way toward helping you keep data secure.

...

1. TAKE STOCK . Know what personal information you have in your files and on your computers.
2. SCALE DOWN . Keep only what you need for your business.
3. LOCK IT . Protect the information that you keep.
4. PITCH IT . Properly dispose of what you no longer need.
5. PLAN AHEAD .

...

## 3. LOCK IT. Protect the information that you keep.
### Electronic Security
#### General Network Security

#### Digital Copiers
To find out more, read [Copier Data Security: A Guide for Businesses](https://www.ftc.gov/tips-advice/business-center/guidance/digital-copier-data-security-guide-businesses) .

#### Detecting Breaches
* To detect network breaches when they occur, consider using an intrusion detection system. To be effective, it must be updated frequently to address new types of hacking.
* Maintain central log files of security-related information to monitor activity on your network so that you can spot and respond to attacks.

...

### Employee Training
Visit [**ftc.gov/startwithsecurity**](http://ftc.gov/startwithsecurity) to show them videos on vulnerabilities that could affect your company, along with practical guidance on how to reduce data security risks.
* Tell employees about your company policies regarding keeping information secure and confidential.
